title.zh: 将菲律宾师范学院改设为名为菲律宾师范大学的州立大学的法案
title.en: An Act Converting the Philippine Normal College into a State University to be known as the Philippine Normal University
title.orig: An Act Converting the Philippine Normal College into a State University to be known as the Philippine Normal University

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 5 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1991/ra_7168_1991.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Philippine Normal College in the City of Manila with branches in the Municipality of Prosperidad in the Province of Agusan, Municipality of Alicia in the Province of Isabela, Cadiz City in the Province of Negros Occidental and Municipality of Lopez in the Province of Quezon is hereby converted into a state university to be known as the Philippine Normal University, hereinafter referred to as the University. The main campus of the University shall be in the City of Manila.

The University shall primarily provide higher professional and special instructions for special purposes and to promote research and extension services, advance studies and progressive leadership in education and other fields as may be relevant.
The University shall offer undergraduate and graduate courses in the fields of education and other degree courses as the Board of Regents may deem necessary to carry out its objectives.

The University shall have the general powers of a corporation set forth in the Corporation Law. The Administration of the University and the exercise of its corporate powers shall be vested exclusively in the Board of Regents and the President of the University insofar as authorized by the Board.

The governing body of the University shall be the Board of Regents, hereinafter referred to as the Board, which shall be composed of the following:
Secretary of Education, Culture and Sports, Chairman
